Domestic institutions similarly liquidated their positions entirely, dropping from 2.80% down to 0.00% over the exact same timeframe [E3]. This complete exodus of both foreign and domestic institutional backing signals a profound lack of professional conviction in the company's underlying fundamentals or valuation [E2, E3]. Compounding this institutional vacuum, the rules-based screen registers a thoroughly mediocre score of just 50 out of 100, characterized as neutral with only medium confidence [E7]. Furthermore, promoters have steadfastly maintained their heavy skin-in-the-game commitment at a rock-solid 72.89% through this entire transition [E1], proving absolute insider alignment while institutional noise cleared out. The rules-based screen score of 50 out of 100 sits squarely at a neutral baseline rather than flashing distress [E7], and the non-cyclical nature of the earnings profile insulates the business from macroeconomic shocks [E6]. Conceded: [E2, E3, E7].

Conceded: [E1]. The bull attempts to frame the complete exit of institutional investors as a positive clearance of noise, but losing 10.03% from foreign institutions and 2.80% from domestic institutions down to absolute zero represents a total institutional abandonment over a single year [E2, E3]. A rules-based screen score of exactly 50 out of 100 sits precisely at a mediocre, uninspiring midpoint rather than indicating any underlying strength [E7]. While the healthcare sector boasts positive tailwinds and growth metrics [E8, E10, E11], Aptus Pharma Ltd itself displays a completely neutral institutional money flow signal (+0.00 percentage point change) that fails to capitalize on those macro tailwinds [E4]. Furthermore, a non-cyclical earnings profile [E6] merely describes the business nature and does not insulate the company from the severe lack of professional market confidence demonstrated by institutional desertion [E2, E3].
